questions.prompt: GTA 6's install size is officially out — the countdown suddenly has a download bar and a storage question. Tonight, the wait just got real. Where are you with it right now?

options.text: Clearing space right now — making room for the big one.
Checking the numbers — how many gigs, really?
Leaving it be — the download can sort itself out.
Staring at a full drive — something's got to go.

questions.prompt: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4's reviews are out and everyone's weighing in — the lobby's calling, the verdicts are landing. Tonight, the reviews are the moment. Where's your head at?

options.text: Diving in tonight — reviews or no reviews.
Reading every review first — I want the full picture.
Waiting to hear what my people say.
Sitting this one out — the noise is too much tonight.

questions.prompt: The Elden Ring movie could run nearly three hours — a whole evening, one world, no shortcuts. Your night's on the line. What's the call?

options.text: Clearing the whole night — big screen, no interruptions.
Splitting it in two — slow and easy, no rush.
Waiting for the streaming cut — the couch can wait.
Three hours? My whole evening just evaporated.

questions.prompt: World Series night — the table's set, the room's locked in, and the biggest stage in baseball is on the screen. If tonight's your watch party, what's on the table?

options.text: The ballpark spread — popcorn, peanuts, the works.
Something warm and slow — a pot that took all afternoon.
Finger food — something to graze on between innings.
Something light — I want to stay locked in, not weighed down.

questions.prompt: The Jay-Z halftime debate is everywhere — the Super Bowl stage, the biggest show in music, and everyone's picturing who owns it. Step into that stadium tonight: what does the show sound like to you?

options.text: The anthem everyone sings along to.
The deep cut only the real fans know.
The beat drop — the whole place erupts.
The slow build — lights down, crowd holding its breath.

questions.prompt: GTA 6's countdown is ticking — the install size is out, the wait has a shape now, and the whole city is warming up. The next hour is yours. What do you want the wait to feel like?

options.text: Buzzing — counting down, ready to go.
Steady — I'll get there when I get there.
Warming up — knocking little things off the list first.
Scattered — too many tabs open, none of them the game.
